sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Semiconductor equipment stocks collectively exploded higher and led the market: AMAT +12.5% (701.72), ALAB +14.4%, GLW +13.1%, KLAC +10.2%, and LRCX +8.8% all hit fresh all-time highs, as market rumors that Korean memory giants are increasing capital expenditures (capex) ignited the entire equipment chain. SOXL +7.0%, driving QQQ up 1.96% (719.48), SPY +1.22% (738.25), and DIA +0.68%.
  • A violent V-shaped bear trap played out at the open: SPY was smashed to an intraday low of 732.12 at around 10 a.m. before rallying all the way back above 738; QQQ rebounded from a low of 705 to above 720. The damage was even more severe in the heavily hit memory segment—MU plunged intraday to 1024.78 (about -9%) before nearly fully recovering to 1112.57 (now -1.0%); AMD bounced from 495.9 back to 529 (+1.7%); INTC rallied from 118.57 back to 127.65 and turned flat; COHR recovered from 341.68 back to 380 and turned flat.
  • The DRAM antitrust lawsuit remains an overhang on memory stocks: On 6/25, a class-action lawsuit filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California accused Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron of conspiring since late 2022 to reduce DDR3/DDR4 capacity, raising prices by roughly 700% over four years, and seeking treble damages. Today, MU failed to turn positive and closed slightly negative, while SNDK -4.3% (2002, after plunging intraday to 1896) still had not recovered, making it one of the few strong stocks left behind.
  • The Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that Trump cannot fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook for now, but on the same day ruled 6-3 to uphold his firing of FTC Commissioner Slaughter and expand presidential personnel authority over independent agencies. The community viewed this as one of the V-shaped catalysts that protected Fed independence.
  • Strong rotation in Mag7 supported the market: TSLA +6.4% (403, no obvious news, pure short squeeze), GOOGL +4.6% (broke above 351), AMZN +4.0%, META +2.5%; only MSFT -1.0% (367.96, steadily sold off from 377 at the open) became the public enemy of the entire market.
  • Geopolitical desensitization: The U.S. and Iran are scheduled to resume talks in Doha on Tuesday, with both sides agreeing to freedom of navigation for vessels; Israeli Defense Minister Katz warned that war would begin if Iran fires missiles. Oil prices rebounded, with USO +1.9%, but CVX -1.0% and OXY flat, as energy stocks remained weak.

社区气氛：总体而言，情绪很快从开盘时的极度恐慌转变为夹杂着兴奋和自嘲的看涨基调——在经历了“一小时内从绝望到狂喜”的V型冲跌之后，大多数人对内存/半导体的逢低买进感到欣慰，但人们普遍对这种低成交量的反弹持怀疑态度，并对午后是否会再次出现“季末再平衡抛售”以及韩国隔夜情绪是否会出现警惕。会变成负值。

恐惧/贪婪：盘中波动剧烈，但整体情绪偏向贪婪。恐惧指数在开盘时立即飙升（“这是我交易生涯中最可怕的一天”），但在 V 型复苏之后，情绪转变为“在赌场里喜极而泣”。 MSFT 持有者是唯一仍处于持续痛苦之中的群体。

情绪与实际市场行为：社区一边疯狂喊叫“假反弹/低成交量陷阱/保证抛售”，一边疯狂追涨，表现出典型的逆势自我意识。实际价格走势是稳步小量上涨，而 IWM -0.37% 变成红色，揭示了明显的结构性背离——指数受到 Mag7 和半导体的支撑，而小盘股则落后。
